justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/CloseableURLConnection.java` (275 lines). The class has one field (`URLConnection urlConnection`) and its methods are almost entirely one-line delegations plus two factory methods and `close()`, so it behaves as a thin adapter that adds `AutoCloseable` to a `URLConnection`, not as a class with multiple decomposable responsibilities. Call sites in `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/IOUtils.java` and `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/FileUtils.java` use it only for that narrow purpose.
